d: A bulky, heavy-set build encased in a high-tech, charcoal-grey and black tactical power armor suit with glowing neon-green accents throughout. The face is entirely obscured by a sleek, dark metallic helmet featuring a glowing cyan-blue visor. The outfit consists of thick plated chest armor, reinforced shoulder guards, heavy gauntlets, and armored greaves, paired with dark grey cargo trousers. Signature details include a massive, black tactical shield with a glowing blue rectangular screen and a red top edge held in one hand, and a small sidearm holstered at the hip.
